title: Identification for a contact already disabled when it arrives
description: The other half of the design doc's O8 (driver identification for a deactivated contact). Driver A is deactivated by the scenario before this trip starts, then identified during the open trip: HARDBRAKE at 30, identification at 70, trip end at 150. Must prove: the row persists with A's contact and records the contact as inactive (flags.contact_is_active false); it is never eligible, so the identification consumer does no trip lookup and the row stays unlinked while the trip is open; at trip end the trip-end consumer links it to the trip and awards no claim. Must NOT change: the asset assignee, the trip assignee, or the violation's attribution. O8 covers a contact deactivated after its row was written.

violation that must stay unassigned to A
